metadata.description: UAEH — Universal Agentic Engineering Harness: a working method for coding with AI agents, as Claude Code plugins. Método de trabajo con agentes de IA, empaquetado como plugins de Claude Code.

plugins.name: uaeh-kit
plugins.description: Layer 1: the method's rules plus a token-efficiency kit (context-map injection, context watchdog, CLAUDE.md diet, usage measurement, status line). Informative only. / Capa 1: reglas del método + kit de eficiencia de tokens. Solo informa.

plugins.name: uaeh-harness
plugins.description: Layers 2 and 3: verification harness (independent verifier and security reviewer with a read-only lock, integrity seal, task ledger, closing guard, two-layer git guard), the uae-security gate (scanners, Codex second opinion, no-network sandbox on a pinned Linux engine) the on-demand uae-visual gate (Playwright + axe checks, browser verifier, design auditor) and the on-demand uae-preflight (launch documents sealed with a risk-based validity). Hooks that block. / Capas 2 y 3: arnés de verificación, puerta de seguridad, auditoría visual y preflight bajo pedido; hooks que bloquean.
